Name: CREAL
Description:
CREAL brings natural vision to Augmented Reality.

AR glasses and headsets are meant to blend the digital and physical worlds, helping us see, learn, and work with greater clarity, confidence, and ease. Enhanced by AI, they’re already transforming fields like medicine, manufacturing, and automotive. Soon, they’ll extend into everyday life, gradually replacing our smartphones and laptops to become the next essential tool.

And an everyday tool must feel natural, healthy, and effortless.

Today’s smart glasses can’t deliver that. By projecting flat 2D images — or, at best, a simulated 3D — they keep digital content hovering apart from reality, while inferring headache and nausea to its user due to visual conflicts. Incremental display tweaks won’t fix it. The industry needs a revolution.

That’s where CREAL steps in, by building an entirely new kind of display. A real 3D display.

CREAL’s patented light field technology projects light rays exactly as they behave in the real world, enabling genuine 3D digital imagery. The digital content blends seamlessly with the surroundings, offering continuous focal depth for a truly natural, healthy and comfortable visual experience.

Combined with transparent and prescription lenses, CREAL’s display provides AR manufacturers with the missing ingredient to finally make AR glasses ready for everyday life.

Name: One Drop One Solutions
Description:
We are on a mission to reduce the impact of human activities on potable water reserves providing the most advanced, efficient, sustainable, smart irrigation solution. At an affordable price. For everyone.

You don’t need to waste water to let your plants shine

US Environmental Protection Agency (EPA) says that a properly managed irrigation system can save more than 7'000 liters of potable water per year per household, while fully preserving the beauty of your garden. This is more than twice as much what World Health Organization (WHO) indicates as the minimum quantity needed by a person in a developing nation. Just think about it.

This inspired us to look for a system that through the use of the latest technology would be able to save water while keeping the highest standard of health and beauty for plants and flowers: ODO

ODO is a service offered by One Drop One Solutions (Switzerland). Led by a core team of top scientists and entrepreneurs from CERN, Bocconi University, LUISS, and IED, the company specializes in designing, engineering and producing the smart and sustainable gardening solutions of the future. Every day, the One Drop One team works together towards a shared vision of reducing the impact of human activities on potable water reserves. One Drop One is headquartered in Geneva, Switzerland and is supported by the State of Geneva’s start-up incubator Fongit.

ODO is a the most advanced, efficient, sustainable smart multi-valve irrigation solution system for your terraces and gardens. Designed in Italy and engineered in Switzerland, ODO is composed by a controller, a gateway, sensors, sprinklers and managed through a mobile app. It works on an innovative and proprietary low frequency data transmission protocol - with low battery consumption - that is 5 times more effective than WiFi in terms of coverage.
